$comment: Seven invented payments cases for the demo, from the invented bank Meridian Trust Bank. The customers, payments, banks and messages do not exist. Investigation: INV-5001 (arrived, held at the correspondent bank until its next processing day), INV-5002 (short by a charge that should not have been taken), INV-5003 (returned, account closed). Repair: REP-7001 (IBAN digits swapped), REP-7002 (wrong BIC), REP-7003 (no address), REP-7004 (no purpose code). The dates are as at the bank date 2026-11-24: start the invented bank with BANK_TODAY=2026-11-24 so that the records the agent reads agree with them. Each case names only what the bank's payments system holds.

cases.title: Rosalind Heathcote-Brae, USD 1,850.00

IBAN: XT09TESL61000220004417
Reference: Deposit for rented flat

MESSAGES ON FILE

Message: MSG-6001-2, pacs.002, inbound, 21 Nov 2026

WHY IT IS HERE

Stopped: The BIC QNMKXQQ1 belongs to another bank than the bank named in the payment (Tessaly Mutual Bank), and the bank code TESL inside the IBAN agrees with the name.
